title: MZ Using Multiple Cursors Per Map

posts.author: weekendrockstar
posts.body:
I apologize if this would belong somewhere else so please feel free to move it if necessary.  I have employed a plugin to
try to make this happen but I am not sure if there is a workaround within RPG Maker or in tandem with a plugin to do what I am attempting.
Currently I am using the Plus version of Mimmosa Mouse Cursor plugin and set a 'default' 'battle' and 'menu' cursor which all work fine.  But there are things that I would also like to change to specific cursors such as an NPC event that leads to dialog (a message icon cursor), a cursor for door events (Door icon cursor, a cursor for events where I "hide" gold/items in an item sprite (magnifying glass) to name a few.  Basically just trying to change icons when any of these events are hovered over to let players know that there are actions they can perform on the map.
In Mimmosa I created several of my own predefined cursors.  When creating each event I use a script call to the JS plugin using the predefined cursor name I want displayed.  But no matter how I attempt it, it just uses that cursor on the entire map instead of the "default" icon I stated in Mimmosa.
I am wondering if there is a way for different events to change the icon when hovering the mouse over it.  No matter what I still want to use Mimmosa as I do want to change the overall cursor used in the game but I feel that it might provide some guidance if a player could put their cursor over a character/door/item hiding a reward and see that they can interact with it.
I appreciate any and all thoughts even if they are..."No, you cannot do that".  Thank you!

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Haven't used the plugin, but the front page says it has an option to change cursor on event hover. Are you saying that's not working properly (or can't be used to differentiate between events)? You should show screenshots, so maybe someone can help you. If there's a command to manually change the cursor, I guess you could try to put a parallel event that checks your mouse coordinates and then checks if there's an event id on those coordinates with get location info and then changes the cursor according to that.
